title: Balance signal coverage against telemetry cost
description: Choose dimensions, sampling, logs, and retention. The model updates ingest, failure capture, active series, and budget pressure together.

workloads.label: Checkout path
workloads.detail: 25k requests/sec, 18 services, and rare high-value failures.

workloads.label: Collaboration API
workloads.detail: 90k requests/sec, short traces, and a moderate error rate.

workloads.label: Data platform
workloads.detail: 8k jobs/sec, long asynchronous traces, and many owned services.

metricPolicies.label: Route, status, and region
metricPolicies.detail: Stable dimensions support operations without encoding identity.

metricPolicies.label: Add method, tier, and dependency
metricPolicies.detail: More diagnostic slices, with a larger series and query budget.

metricPolicies.label: Add request and customer IDs
metricPolicies.detail: Unique values make the active series count unbounded.

samplingPolicies.label: Random head sampling
samplingPolicies.detail: Decide at trace start, before the result or latency is known.

samplingPolicies.label: Outcome-aware tail sampling
samplingPolicies.detail: Retain all errors plus a sample of healthy traces after completion.

logPolicies.label: Errors only
logPolicies.detail: Low volume, but normal decisions around the failure may be absent.

logPolicies.label: Structured boundary events
logPolicies.detail: Record owned decisions, state changes, and classified failures.

logPolicies.label: Debug every internal step
logPolicies.detail: High volume and sensitive-data risk with little prioritization.
